Parses Debian OVAL XML data and converts it into structured vulnerability definition models for storage and querying.

## Key Components

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `distroPackage` | struct | Internal type pairing an OS version string with a `models.Package` |
| `ConvertToModel` | func | Converts a parsed OVAL `Root` into a slice of `models.Definition` |
| `collectDebianPacks` | func | Entry point for extracting affected packages from OVAL `Criteria` |
| `walkDebian` | func | Recursively traverses nested `Criteria`/`Criterias` trees to extract package name/version pairs |

## Usage Example

```go
root := &debian.Root{} // populated by XML parsing upstream
defs := debian.ConvertToModel(root)

for _, def := range defs {
    fmt.Println(def.DefinitionID, def.Debian.DSA)
    for _, pack := range def.AffectedPacks {
        fmt.Printf("  %s < %s\n", pack.Name, pack.Version)
    }
}
```

## Behavior Notes

- **Rejected CVEs**: Definitions containing `"** REJECT **"` in their description are silently skipped.
- **Zero-version packages**: Packages with version `"0"` are excluded, as this signals unfixed or erroneous entries.
- **`no-details` mode**: When `viper` flag `no-details` is `true`, sensitive/verbose fields (`Title`, `Description`, `References`, `Debian`, advisory metadata) are cleared before appending to results.
- **Package extraction**: Criterion comments matching the pattern `<name> DPKG is earlier than <version>` are parsed to populate `models.Package`. OS version is inferred from comments like `Debian <ver> is installed`.
- **Date parsing**: DSA dates are parsed via `util.ParsedOrDefaultTime` with layout `"2006-01-02"`, falling back to a default time on failure.
